title: A lisse sheaf on a normal open has constructible direct image
statement:
Let $X$ be integral of finite type over a field, let
$k:V\hookrightarrow X$ be a nonempty
normal open,
and let $L$ be a finite locally constant module sheaf
over a finite ring. Then the
direct image $k_*L$
is constructible.

proof.text: The finite-type, quasi-compact structure map to the spectrum of the field makes X Noetherian (LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace). The generic point of X lies in the nonempty open V, so lift X.fromSpecFunctionField through k, obtaining t: Spec k(X) -> V with t k = X.fromSpecFunctionField. Pullback preserves finite local constancy, and the trivial stratification makes F=t^*L constructible. Convert to IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf and use constructible_field_finite_separable_constant to obtain a finite separable E/k(X), a finite coefficient module M, and pi^*F isomorphic to M_E.

Set h=pi t: Spec E -> V. Transpose h^*L isomorphic to M_E under h^* adjoint to h_* to obtain phi:L -> h_*M_E. Its pullback composed with the counit equals the trivializing isomorphism, hence is monic on any geometric stalk of Spec E. Naturality of Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso transports this monicity to the stalk of phi over the generic point of V. Apply the module-valued source-library generic-kernel theorem Etale.mono_of_mono_sheafFiber_of_isLocallyConstantSheaf (the module version of lem-weil-pbc-lisse-generic-kernel). Thus phi is mono.

Construct Y=X.normalizationIn E with nu:Y -> X, and g:Spec E -> Y the canonical generic map. The map nu is finite by Scheme.isFinite_fromNormalizationIn. Its local rings are integrally closed by Scheme.Hom.isIntegrallyClosed_stalk_normalization, since E is a field. Scheme.exists_iso_toNormalization_normalizationIn identifies g, up to an isomorphism of field spectra, with Y.fromSpecFunctionField. Thus the constant generic-unit theorem gives M_Y isomorphic to g_*M_E; transport the unit using Etale.isIso_unit_app_comp and identify pullbacks of constants with constants.

Push phi forward by k_*; this preserves monomorphisms because it preserves finite limits. The equalities h k=f=g nu and the direct-image composition isomorphisms identify k_* h_*M_E with nu_* g_*M_E and hence with nu_*M_Y. Their composite gives a monomorphism psi:k_*L -> nu_*M_Y.

The finite module M is finitely generated, and the geometric stalk of the constant sheaf M_Y is M, by sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. Hence M_Y is finite locally constant and therefore constructible for the trivial stratification. Apply the source-library module theorem Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf.lowerStar_of_isFinite to nu and M_Y (the finite-ring specialization of finite constructible module pushforward), and convert its conclusion with isConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf_iff. The constructible-subobject theorem applied to psi gives the desired constructibility of k_*L.

proof_origin.place: C5: shorter generic-field variant of the finite-normalization, constant-image, finite-pushforward and subobject argument. Generic trivialization uses the existing Stacks 09Z6 field lemma; generic injectivity uses the existing lisse generic-kernel theorem.
